name: rusty-locale-updated
title: Rusty's Locale Utilities: Updated
author: TheRustyKnife; FactorioMods (Factorio 2.1 port)
description: Factorio 2.1 compatibility fork of rusty-locale. A set of helper functions for resolving proper localised names and descriptions of prototypes, including recipes and items. There are also utilities for resolving prototype icons, because why not?
